title: Assert exact artifact and original outcomes in positive retired-check disposition coverage
outcome: Positive disposition tests distinguish artifactOutcome unknown from immutable original verification outcome and receipt outcome through parsed disclosure, rather than prompt substrings.
acceptance: Passed, failed and missing-artifact cases assert the exact parsed artifactOutcome and originalVerification.run.outcome values independently.
The original registration, acknowledgement, verification-body and no-credit assertions remain strict and observable.
